subject: POC Kickoff & Timeline - ZetaCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zetacorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff & Timeline - ZetaCorp

Hi Alex —

Great to talk earlier today. Summary & proposed plan from our call so we have a shared record:

Summary of goals / success criteria
- Validate Redwood inference can meet ZetaCorp's latency target (< 200ms p95) on sample queries.
- Demonstrate inference cost at or below your target ($0.002/token equivalent).
- Confirm integration feasibility with your VPC/S3 data flow and RBAC model.

Proposed timeline
- Kickoff: week of Jun 22 (I propose Wed, Jun 24, 10:00am PT) — onboarding & infra access.
- Week 1 (Jun 24–26): dataset ingestion, environment access, baseline perf run.
- Week 2 (Jun 29–Jul 3): tuning (batching/quant profiles), mid-POC readout.
- Ongoing: weekly check-ins (Fridays, 30m).
- Final readout: Fri, Jul 22 — performance and cost review.

Owners
- Redwood: Dev Patel (technical lead) — infra, model config, runbooks.
- ZetaCorp: Alex Johnson (project sponsor), Sanjay Rao (procurement/legal).

Next steps / asks
1) Can you confirm the kickoff date/time (I proposed Jun 24, 10:00am PT)?
2) Please share sample data access (S3 path) and a contact for networking/VPC setup.
3) If procurement/legal needs our SOW, attaching POC_SOW_v1.pdf and an editable timeline (POC_timeline_sheet.xlsx).

I’ll send a calendar invite after you confirm. Thanks again — excited to get started.
\Best,\Marissa Cole\Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference\marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com\+1 (415) 555-0183\nAttachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf, POC_timeline_sheet.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and matches what we discussed. A couple quick notes:

- Jun 24 at 10:00am PT works better for people on my side if we keep it to 60 minutes for kickoff.
- Can you confirm what credentials you need vs. what we should provision? Our network team prefers we create an IAM role for access; we can provide an S3 bucket with sample data.
- Procurement (Sanjay) will start a quick review of the SOW and loop in legal if needed — they generally need around 5 business days.

Also, success criteria — can we add "no PII exfiltration and logs retained for 90 days" to be explicit (we can share minimal requirements)?

Appreciate it,\Alex\nOn Thu, Jun 18, 2026 at 3:22 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming: kickoff Wed, Jun 24, 10:00am PT, 60 minutes. I sent the calendar invite (please accept when you can).

Credentials / access
- For initial runs we only need read access to a sample S3 path and a plain list of example queries (CSV). If you prefer, we can also run with a presigned URL approach — whichever your network team is comfortable with.
- On security: we will sign a mutual NDA if required and will follow your retention and logging requirements. Adding "no PII exfiltration" and "90-day logs" to success criteria is fine — we'll include that in the SOW update.

Action items (owners)
- Alex / ZetaCorp: provide S3 path + example query CSV, and procurement contact for SOW next steps.
- Dev Patel (Redwood): prepare infra checklist and runbook for kickoff.
- Neha (CS): will schedule weekly 30m check-ins and track success criteria.

I attached the SOW and timeline again here for easy reference.
\Marissa\nAttachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf, POC_timeline_sheet.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll lead the technical setup. Quick ask for the kickoff prep:
- Can you send a small sample dataset (CSV or JSONL) plus a short list (~25) of representative queries?
- Network: please share whether you prefer IAM role or presigned-URL; if IAM, I’ll send an ARN for the role we need.
- Any special tokenization or privacy masking you want us to apply pre-ingest?

I’ll draft the infra checklist and share before the meeting.

Sanjay — looping you in for procurement.

Perfect — thanks everyone. Final checklist & cadence below so we all have it in one place:

Confirmed timeline
- Kickoff: Wed, Jun 24, 10:00am PT — 60m (invite sent).
- Weekly check-ins: Fridays, 30m, starting Jun 26. Invite recurring.
- Mid-POC readout: week of Jul 6 (raw perf + tuning notes).
- Final readout: Fri, Jul 22 (final perf, cost estimate, integration notes).

Success criteria (final)
1) p95 latency < 200ms for representative queries.
2) Inference cost at or below $0.002/token equivalent (billing model TBD).
3) No PII exfiltration; logs retained 90 days.
4) Successful integration test with your S3/VPC setup.

Action owners & next steps
- ZetaCorp (Alex): provide IAM role ARN + sample data link (actioned).
- ZetaCorp (Sanjay): procurement to review SOW (Sanjay to update DocuSign).
- Redwood (Dev): infra checklist & runbook (deliver before Jun 24).
- Redwood (Neha): recurring calendar + success criteria tracking doc.
- Redwood (Marissa): monitor timeline & provide weekly agenda templates.

Related links: HubSpot deal, SOW in Drive, DocuSign SOW (links in header).
\If there are no objections I’ll update the SOW to reflect the privacy & logging language and send to Sanjay for signature.
\Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
